rawRecord.short_description: Enables private payments on Starknet through zero-knowledge cryptographic operations and privacy-preserving transaction management
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with MIST.cash SDK to enable privacy-preserving payments on Starknet blockchain. Provides tools for generating transaction secrets using claiming keys and recipient addresses, calculating transaction hashes, fetching transaction assets, verifying transaction existence for fully private transactions, and retrieving Chamber contract configuration. Supports multiple tokens including ETH, USDC, USDT, and DAI with robust validation using Zod schemas and retry logic with exponential backoff for network operations.
